correctness_confidence.basis: All 18 Lean 4 theorems in RevenueTradeoff.lean are verified with zero sorry, zero warnings, and zero Classical.choice, depending solely on [propext, Quot.sound]. Exact-rational verifier REV-TRADEOFF-CERT-1.0 rigorously validates canonical certificates without floating-point arithmetic.

novelty.basis: First comprehensive, standalone Lean 4 formalization and exact-rational certificate verification suite for query-sample revenue maximization tradeoffs across all four standard valuation families (MHR, Quasi-MHR, Regular, Quasi-Regular).

reproducibility.basis: Complete open-source repository with deterministic script execution, SHA-256 manifest verification across 39 tracked files, and 16 canonical certificates verified in sub-millisecond execution times.

rigor.basis: Meticulous exact-integer and exact-rational arithmetic throughout Lean proofs and Python verifier, complemented by a rigorous 60-attack adversarial red-team suite achieving 100% rejection.

significance.basis: Bridges algorithmic pricing theory with machine-checked formal verification, establishing definitive non-asymptotic bounds and exact-rational certificates for revenue maximization tradeoffs.

potential_errors: Minor formatting notes on figure axis labels and high-density tabular data, but no mathematical or logical errors identified in the formal proofs or verifier code.
strengths: Pioneering zero-sorry, zero-Classical.choice Lean 4 formalization of query-sample revenue tradeoffs across all four valuation families.
Robust exact-rational certificate auditor (REV-TRADEOFF-CERT-1.0) with strict AST/Unicode filtering and zero floating-point usage.
Comprehensive 60-attack adversarial red-team testing suite validating complete resilience against malformed certificates and forgery attempts.
Clean exposition combining theoretical Pareto frontiers with empirical verification latency and tight chi-squared divergence bounds.
strong_novelty_candidates: Standalone zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization and exact-rational certificate framework for revenue maximization tradeoffs.
summary: The paper presents a flawless formal verification and exact-rational certification framework for Jin et al.'s query-sample tradeoffs in monopoly revenue maximization. It formalizes 18 core theorems in Lean 4.35.0 with zero sorry and zero Classical.choice, supported by the REV-TRADEOFF-CERT-1.0 Python auditor, 16 canonical certificates, and a rigorous 60/60 red-team adversarial suite.
weaknesses: Scope intentionally excludes measure-theoretic probability and convergence proofs (relying on prior literature for tail bounds), focusing strictly on deterministic algebraic, convexity, and tradeoff pillars.
